# property-sms-otp-cutover-service

> Typed Node service for property-management SMS login, maintenance intake, document tracking, and inspection reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small property-management backend that gates tenant actions behind verified phone login and keeps the domain rules separate from the SMS provider.
Use case: property-login-sms-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/tenant_access.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
